title: note_prompt_delivery_outcome stamps the session row even when no receipt moves; narrow the receipt module's blanket allow(dead_code)
outcome: note_prompt_delivery_outcome stamps the session row even when no receipt moves; narrow the receipt module's blanket allow(dead_code)
acceptance: note_prompt_delivery_outcome (src/prompt_delivery.rs) checks for a HandingOff delivery of the given turn under an immutable borrow before taking the stamping session_mut_by_index, so Codex turn/started, turn finishes and Claude lifecycle frames of a session with only settled receipts no longer rewrite its row.
The #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] on the receipt impl block is narrowed to the producer entry points awaiting wiring (w-6e77124334c1), so other unused helpers are reported.
